Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[Lieutenant Dopheld Mitaka (Errata)]] (PC-E1), game text: “When drawn for destiny, use 1 Force or this card is lost. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your deploy phase, may use 3 Force to relocate Kylo from here to same site as a Resistance Agent.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata-072022.pdf Errata Sheet July 2022] (Players Committee), page 1, PDF built 29 June 2022. The slip is the image embedded in the PDF; its transparent areas (where the card underneath shows through) are shown white.

Edits: none.
